maverick.gloss: Merriam-Webster's Word of the Day for July 23, 2026 is: maverick  \MAV-rik\   noun Maverick refers to a person who refuses to follow the customs or rules of a group; in other words, a nonconformist . // Ayo has always been a bit of a maverick in the fashion world, inventing new trends rather than following them.
